stem: Which line from the poem best indicates that the speaker is ready to relinquish ownership of the desk?

options.label: A
options.text: Older than you by far, it sits in your room (line 28)

options.label: B
options.text: piled high with crayon drawings, coins, trolls, and hot wheels cars. (line 29)

options.label: C
options.text: You’re still too young to do algebra homework. (line 30)

options.label: D
options.text: and paint it to match your bright green and lavender dreams. (line 35)
